definitions.explanation: Bags and belongings that passengers carry with them onto a plane, train, or other transportation, as opposed to checked luggage.

examples.japanese: {手荷物|てにもつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です。
examples.english: You can have only one piece of carry-on luggage.

examples.japanese: {手荷物|てにもつ}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please go through the baggage inspection.

examples.japanese: {手荷物|てにもつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please store your hand luggage under your seat or in the overhead bin.

notes:
A common travel term used at airports and train stations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手荷物|てにもつ}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (baggage inspection/security check)
- {手荷物|てにもつ}⟦{預|あず}かり{所|じょ}→預かり所：24116_azukarijo⟧ (baggage storage/left luggage)
- {手荷物|てにもつ}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ (carry-on restrictions)
- {手荷物|てにもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧ (to bring carry-on luggage)
